newsitem.title: USA: National Patent General Physics buy advances.
newsitem.headline: National Patent General Physics buy advances.

text.p: National Patent Development Corp said Thursday it has definitively agreed with General Physics Corp to buy the 48 percent of General Physics it doesn't already own for $5.10 per share.

The companies, which announced their intention to merge in September, said the agreement was recommended to General Physics' board by a special committee of independent directors. It is subject to approval by stockholders of both companies.
Among other things, the deal depends in part on whether National Patent's common shares rise above their current price of $8.50.
Under the agreement the exchange ratio would be 0.53 National Patent share for each General Physics share if National Patent's market price were between $9.336 and $9.914 per share.
National Patent shares were unchanged Thursday morning at 8-1/2.

National Patent said the agreement allows it to lift the exchange ratio so that General Physics holders would get National Patent shares with a value per share of General Physics common equal to $4.95.
If it did not exercise this option, General Physics could end the agreement, National Patent said.
